spans.s:
adj. masc. only. (-शः)
Small, little.
subst.
1 Smallness, littleness.
2 A little.
E.
लिश to be small, aff. घञ्, some authorities vary the gender of the attribute.

m. (-ष्टुः)
A clod of earth.
E.
लिश to become less or small, तुन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-घ्नः)
A harrow.
E.
लेष्टु a clod of earth, and घ्न destroying.

m. (-नः)
A harrow.
E.
लेष्टु a clod of earth, and भेदन breaking; also लेष्टुभेदिन् and लोष्टभेदन, &c.

m. (-कः)
The rider on an elephant, who sits on the animal's loins.
